module_summary: 10GBASE-R 64-bit transmit MAC: an FSM takes AXI-Stream frames, adds preamble, padding and CRC32 FCS via LFSR instances, enforces IFG with deficit idle count and lane swapping, and encodes 64b/66b blocks.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main TX FSM: idle, payload, pad, FCS, error, IFG; drives ready, output type and CRC control.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream input valid; starts frames and detects underflow.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: AXI-Stream ready output driven from registered FSM ready.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: 64-bit frame payload input, keep-masked into the data register.

anchors.name: encoded_tx_data
anchors.why: 64b/66b encoded block payload output.

anchors.name: encoded_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header (data/control) of encoded block.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker; moves FSM from payload to pad/FCS.

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Registered input word feeding CRC LFSRs and output data path.

anchors.name: s_empty_reg
anchors.why: Empty-byte count of last word; selects FCS placement and termination type.

anchors.name: crc_state_reg
anchors.why: CRC32 accumulator states for FCS generation per byte count.

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables CRC accumulator update during payload, pad and FCS states.

anchors.name: fcs_output_data_0
anchors.why: Last data word merged with inverted CRC bytes.

anchors.name: output_type_reg
anchors.why: Block type selecting idle/error/start/data/terminate 66b encoding.

anchors.name: output_data_reg
anchors.why: Output stage data word, possibly lane-swapped, fed to encoder.

anchors.name: swap_lanes_reg
anchors.why: Lane swap flag shifting frames by 4 bytes for DIC; alters output type and timestamp.

anchors.name: swap_data
anchors.why: Holds upper 32 bits for lane-swapped output word.

anchors.name: delay_type_valid
anchors.why: Flags a delayed terminate type pending under lane swap.

anchors.name: ifg_count_reg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap countdown keeping FSM in IFG state.

anchors.name: deficit_idle_count_reg
anchors.why: Deficit idle count carried between frames for DIC.

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum frame length; drives padding state.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag; keeps ready high to drop rest of frame, holds IFG.

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error flag steering pad state to error termination.

anchors.name: frame_start_reg
anchors.why: Start-of-frame pulse capturing timestamp and start_packet status.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_masked
anchors.why: Input data with tkeep-masked bytes zeroed.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Transmit enable gating frame start from idle.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length loaded into IFG counter.

anchors.name: error_underflow
anchors.why: Reports input underflow mid-frame.

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet indication with lane position.

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Captured PTP timestamp at frame start (disabled by default).

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: PTP timestamp output, zero when PTP_TS_ENABLE=0.

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: Timestamp valid pulse, disabled by default parameters.

groups.name: TX control FSM
groups.description: Frame sequencing FSM with in-frame, error and start flags.

groups.name: AXIS input stage
groups.description: Accepts AXI-Stream words, masks by tkeep, registers data and empty count.

groups.name: CRC/FCS generator
groups.description: LFSR CRC32 instances and FCS word/type formation by empty count.

groups.name: Lane swap output stage
groups.description: Registers output word and type, optionally shifted by 4 lanes.

groups.name: 64b/66b encoder
groups.description: Maps output type and data to encoded block and sync header.

groups.name: IFG and padding counters
groups.description: Inter-frame gap, deficit idle and minimum-length padding counters.

groups.name: PTP timestamping
groups.description: Optional start-of-frame timestamp capture and adjustment.
